notes: Standalone greenfield fixture. Pre-install layer 00-project commits a one-line README so the repository is not empty. There is no implementation, so the project stays GREENFIELD. The installer then writes the default greenfield state: SCOPING, CycleMode UNSET, Id and Request UNSET, CompletionPolicy NONE, Handoff INITIAL, PendingCycleMode UNSET. No post-install layers are needed because every stated fact is the installed state. Scoper should first run Start a cycle: cycle.mjs new, STANDARD, IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED, with the choice and reason kept in Request, Handoff INITIAL, WorkflowState SCOPING. It may then scope. The checks allow either outcome: still in SCOPING (asking or mid-work), or FORWARD to ARCHITECTING.
